lines.en: label day244:
scene utapoachesio1
: Poke.
: Pokey-poke poke.
: Pokey-pokey-pokey-pokey-poke.
So, I bet you’re wondering how I found myself in this situation.
It was a normal day of[school] just like any other.
In fact, it was so normal that it ended without any hiccups and this onslaught of poking came out of virtually nowhere.
Yup.
I know you were expecting a little more detail as to why this small female is now walking alongside me and-
: Pokey-poke.
And doing that.
But I really have no idea.
: Is there something you need from me, Uta?
: You mean I can’t just walk side by side with you and poke you without any ulterior motives?
: Is that what’s happening right now?
: No. I have an ulterior motive.
: And what might that ulterior motive be, exactly?
: You see, Sensei. I’ve got this really good friend who transferred in alongside me...
: And I was just thinking that you would be my favorite person in the whole wide world if you’d be able to...oh, I don’t know-
scene utapoachesio2
: Get her into our class?
: And you think poking me on the way home from[school] is the way to accomplish that?
: Would you prefer I did something a little...extra?
: What did you have in mind?
scene utapoachesio3
: Ah! You thought I was being serious!
: You thought I was offering to do freaky stuff with you just now!
: Why do you torment me like this?
scene utapoachesio4
: I’m sorry, Sensei. But I’m afraid that it is too cold and too wet to be doing freaky stuff right now.
: Plus, this is the only uniform I have and I can't afford it getting all messy.
: So I’m very sorry but I’m going to have to reject you once again.
: Please do not hold this against me. I hope we can continue to remain friends.
: Hah...
: What is your friend’s name?
scene utapoachesio5
: Ah! Are you actually gonna do it?!
: Oh my God! I love you! You’re the best ever!
: I never agreed to anything. I don’t even know if something like that is in my power.
: Really? Cause I talked to her teacher and she said that she’s fine with you taking pretty much everybody out of her class if you want.
: Does your friend’s teacher have purple hair and look like she hasn’t slept in ten years?
: Uh-huh. Just like that, actually.
: Then...maybe there is something I can do after all.
scene utapoachesio6
: Yay!
: Just so you know though, I still can’t get freaky. I’ve barely even settled into my dorm and I wouldn’t even know where to go for something like that.
: I have a house, you know.
scene utapoachesio7
: Ooooooh you sly dog, you. Offering to take a [young_girl] home on her way out of[school].
: Don’t you live with Ami? Won’t she get jealous?
scene utapoachesio8
: Wait! You want both of us! At the same time!
: And in our uniforms!
: I see right through you, Sensei! I had no idea you-
: You really need to tone it down while we’re still on[school] grounds.
scene utapoachesio9
: Yeah, probably. The more I think about it, the more we risk having one of your eleven-hundred girlfriends see us.
: I already lost my first fight to Yumi. I need to train before I’m ready to take on another opponent.
: Right...
: This friend, though-
scene utapoachesio10
: Oh, yeah!
: I was actually thinking, if you aren’t too busy today, the two of us could go pay her a visit so you can get a feel for her.
: Not like a literal feel, though.
: She doesn’t have to call her parents for approval or anything the way I do, but she’s not really a big people-person.
: But hey, who knows? You seem to draw in girls my age, so maybe she’ll be calling you Master soon, too?
: Just in the good way and stuff.
: You really don’t hold anything back in public conversation, do you?
scene utapoachesio11
: My lack of a filter will one-day be my demise.
: But until then, please continue taking care of me~
I will take care of you forever, Uta-chan.
: I don’t have any plans today, so we can go meet her if you’d like.
: Where does she live?
scene utapoachesio12
: You know that bathhouse somewhere between the maid cafe and the[school]? There.
: She lives in a bathhouse?
: Mhm. Her aunt owns the place and she helps run it.
: She’s probably working right now, but as long as you don’t mind naked people walkin’ around all...naked and stuff, we can hang out there.
: I don’t mind naked people at all. I actually prefer them.
Which is something I can safely say now that there are virtually zero men anywhere to be found.
scene utapoachesio10
: Then all aboard the Uta-Express!
: Just not like aboard-aboard, if you know what I mean.
: Right. Because you’d have to call your parents.
: Yeah. This train’s out of service and can’t take on any passengers right now. Sorry, Sensei.
: I can’t tell if I love or hate all of these innuendos.
: You love ‘em. I can see it in those big ole’ pretty eyes of yours.
: Now, come on! We’ve gotta get there before all the old ladies show up and start playin’ strip mahjong in the back room!
: Is that...actually a thing that happens there?
: Probably. You know how old ladies get.
scene black
What Uta does not know is that...I don’t know how old ladies get.
How is that even a thing I would know?
I’ve made it overwhelmingly apparent that I hardly ever associate with anyone out of Uta’s age group- which sounds kind of sickening when I actually put it into words.
But that’s beside the point.
The matter at hand is meeting this friend of hers- who may or may not wind up making my life just as difficult as Uta is.
The girl’s barely left my side since she showed up in[school].
And, even though I don’t really have any problem with that, maybe having someone else she knows around will get her to...ease up a bit?
But, then again, there’s a chance that this will all just crash and burn in the end.
I guess I’ll just have to wait and see.
scene utapoachesio13
Uta leads me into the bathhouse that I’ve been to with Ami and Ayane several times before.
She stops walking abruptly and quickly turns to face me. I can see her friend out of the corner of my eye and I’m slightly confused as to why we’ve yet to approach her.
: Welp. Time to get naked, Sensei.
: Like, both of us?
: Nope. Just you.
: It’s a bathhouse. It’s bad manners to be walking around in your normal clothes.
: But you-
: My friend works here. I don’t have to follow the rules.
: Something tells me I should not be falling for this trick.
: Something tells me somebody is a little self-conscious.
: That is definitely not what’s happening right now.
scene utapoachesio14
: I’m just messin’ with you anyway. But you can’t blame me for being kinda curious.
: Now, come on! I’ll introduce you to Io.
scene black
I shrug off the fact that Uta just...openly admitted to being curious about my penis (?) and follow her to the counter.
scene utapoachesio15
: Welp, here she is! Ain’t she a beaut?
: Yeah, she's adorable.
: Am I...being appraised right now?
: Sure are, Io.
: But anyway, meet Sensei. He’s the best teacher I’ve ever had and I’ve only been in his class for a week.
: Aren’t you that guy who rented out the men’s bath with that one blonde girl a while ago?
: I was really hoping you wouldn’t have remembered that.
scene utapoachesio16
: Blonde girl?!
: Natural blonde or bleach-blonde?!
: That’s the part you want to know more about?...
: I’ve gotta know if it was Ayane or Chika! I need to update your hit-list!
: What if it wasn’t someone from the class?
scene utapoachesio17
: Ah! You scoundrel! How many girls are you seeing?!
scene utapoachesio18
: So like...are you guys here to take baths...or?
: What’s going on right now?
: Oh, no. We’re here for the naked mahjong game with the old ladies in the back.
: How many times do I have to tell you that isn’t a thing we do here?
: I just don’t believe you, Io. I’m sorry.
: Uta here was trying to get you into my class.
scene utapoachesio19
: She was?
: Yup!
: But...why?
: I...actually didn’t ask that.
scene utapoachesio20
: You’ve just seemed really down the last few days and I thought it might pep you up a bit being around me and stuff.
: I know how hard it can be making friends in new-
scene utapoachesio21
: Ugh. Uta, come on. Not this again.
: No, no, no! Hear me out. Sensei is actually a super awesome teacher and already said he’d be fine with taking you into the class.
scene utapoachesio22
: Really?
: Yeah, I guess that’s kind of what happened.
: But why? You don’t even know me.
: I could like, be a serial killer or something.
: Uta vouched for you so that’s good enough for me.
: But also, since I’m going out of my way for you-
: You want me to keep the thing about you and the blonde girl a secret?
: Preferably, yes.
: Sure. Do whatever you want. I'm not a big fan of secrets but if that's all it takes, sure.
: Your business is your business after all.
: Oh, cool. You’re the complete opposite of Uta.
scene utapoachesio23
: Why is that cool?! You love me! I was ready to get freaky after this!
: No you weren’t.
: She hasn’t even called her parents yet.
: See? You’re not the only one who can see through people, Uta.
scene utapoachesio24
: I have so much love to give and no one who will accept it...
: Um...is there like, anything you need from me to help out with the transfer thing?
: Dying to get out that badly?
: I mean...Yeah, a little bit I guess.
: I’m not going to drop out or anything if I stay in Ms. Watabe’s class, but I’d definitely like being around at least one person I know more than...zero of them.
: Also, you’d be the first teacher I’ve ever gotten to see the penis of and that sounds like a fun novelty.
scene utapoachesio25
: Oh great. So that’s a thing you saw.
: What?! Io!
: Your aunt says you’re only supposed to watch the cameras when people are up to no good!
: He’s an older guy who got into a bath with a girl my age. Of course I was going to think he was up to no good.
: Surprisingly, though, nothing happened at all.
: They just sat back to back and talked to each other for like two whole hours.
To be fair, I was totally down to do more than that but Ayane didn’t seem like she was in the best state of mind that night.
scene utapoachesio26
: Really, though. If there’s anything I can do to help make this happen, just ask.
: The more I think about getting out of Ms. Watabe's, the more psyched up I’m getting.
: I’ve always done better with male teachers anyway so this is like, a totally awesome idea.
: Will a discount on bath-stuff sweeten the deal?! Oh! Should I throw in Uta?!
: Disclaimer: Uta is not for sale. Please keep your hands in the vehicle at all times.
: That won’t be necessary.
: I’ll do what I can but I can’t guarantee it will work out.
: I’ve taken in transfer students before but I’ve never stolen one from another class.
: It’s not really stealing if it’s what I want, though, right? You can just tell them I’m not happy in the other class or something.
: Ms. Watabe is kind of a creep anyway.
: She’s definitely...unique.
scene utapoachesio27
: Oh my God, I’m so excited and I haven’t even switched classes yet.
: How many people are in there? Twenty? Twenty-five? Ms. Watabe’s class has like six hundred so-
: You’d be the fourteenth.
scene utapoachesio28
: Only fourteen?!
: Sensei, you know how they call people who are really good at getting along with everybody “social butterflies?”
: Well, Io here is the complete opposite.
: It’s true. I only talk to like two people. Everyone sucks. Please save me.
: How are you two even friends?
: We were pen-pals when we were little!
scene utapoachesio29
: It wasn’t until Uta moved to Kumon-mi that we finally got to meet in person.
: She was a little shorter than I expected. And significantly more female. But I came around to liking her anyway.
: Was Uta...posing as a male online?
scene utapoachesio30
: No...I just had a really...masculine screen name and we never really talked about our genders.
: I kind of...thought Io was going to be a boy as well...
: But yeah, weird origin story aside, thank you so much, Sensei.
: Is it okay if I call you Sensei already?
: I don’t even know what else you would call me.
: And I can move into Uta’s dorm room?
: Do you not have a roommate yet, Uta?
: Well, you see...another one of the reasons I wanted Io to join our class was that I...kind of get really scared at night if there’s no one around.
: And I’ve got all sorts of tools and metal stuff, so I can protect her if it really comes to it.
: Wait, what?
: Don’t worry about it. Just focus on filling out all that paperwork or whatever it is you have to do and I’ll...
: ...You'll what?
: Oh, sorry. I just remembered your penis.
: Okay, I wanted you two to get along but I also wanted things to go a little differently than this.
: Really? She seems pretty great to me, Uta.
scene utapoachesio31
: Thanks.
: There are a lot of words I’d use to describe myself, but “great” isn’t anywhere close to the list.
: And even if you’re only doing this because Uta put you up to it, I’m...glad you’re taking a chance on me.
: I’ll try not to get in your hair.
: And I’ll try to not come to the bathhouse with your future-classmates.
: Again, I don’t really care if you do. Your business is your business.
: Then I will come to the bathhouse with all of them.
: As long as I don’t have to clean up after you, we’re good.
: This is a compromise I am willing to accept.
: Pleasure doing business with you, Io.
: Don’t sweat it. Stop by anytime you like.
: Uta normally takes a bath around 8:00 every night, so if you stop by around then I can look the other way and let you walk in on her.
: Deal.
: Sweet.
scene utapoachesio32
scene utapoachesio33
: Mom?
: I think we need to talk.
scene black
